leads.claim: A rumor circulated that a meteorite recovered in Northern Kansas was something other than an ordinary meteorite, but it was proven to be ordinary.
leads.why: The document explicitly states the recovered object was proven to be an ordinary meteorite, dismissing the anomalous claim.
leads.quote: finally recovered meteorite up there and proved it was everything but an ordinary meteorite fall

leads.claim: Dr. LaPaz notes that while meteorites are usually recovered after sightings, no fragments have been found in the case of the green fireballs.
leads.why: The claim is that no material was recovered, and the discussion centers on the absence of physical evidence for the observed phenomena.
leads.quote: Do you think it is unusual no fragments are found? Dr. LaPaz: I certainly do.

doc_verdict: This document is a transcript of a 1949 scientific conference discussing aerial phenomena and meteorites; it contains no evidence of the government or contractors obtaining or holding UAP-related material.
